company.name: Hotelogix
company.shortDescription: Hotelogix is a cloud-based hotel property management system that offers property management and online distribution system solutions.
company.description: Hotelogix is the WORLD's EASIEST SYSTEM to get started with. Just take the trial now, and you will be amazed with simplicity of their unique sign-up process that will let you setup your property ;for a full blown trial; in less than 10 minutes flat. You will experience a revolutionary system that is well suited for independent hotels, hotel chains, resorts, inns, lodges, bed & breakfast, and other mid sized hospitality setups. Further, based on Software as a Service, Hotelogix presents a simple pay-as-you-go option that lets you start enjoying its benefits without the prohibitive upfront deposits, and absolutely no additional cost of infrastructure.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Venture round round raised $2,140,000, or 21.1% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,398,863 to $39,880,869, a 5.39x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 45 (-5 over 90 days) and market heat at 37 (-10).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set

insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
